📍 Lambasingi · Visakhapatnam Dist.

"The Kashmir
of Andhra Pradesh"

Nestled at 1,000m above sea level, Lambasingi is the only location in South India to experience snowfall. With misty mornings, lush strawberry farms, ancient tribal cultures and untouched forest trails — it's a destination unlike any other.

❄ Snowfall in Winter 🍓 Strawberry Capital 🏔 1000m Elevation 🌿 Forest Trails 🏡 Tribal Culture ☕ Coffee Plantations
1000m
Elevation
8+
Attractions
12
Homestays
Oct–Feb
Best Season
🌡

Cool Climate

Avg 8–15°C in winter. Carry warm layers — it can feel like a hill station year-round.

🚌

How to Reach

5 hrs from Visakhapatnam by road via Chintapalle. Nearest railhead: Visak (130km).

📱

Connectivity

Limited mobile signal (BSNL works best). WiFi available at select homestays.

🏥

Safety

Nearest hospital in Chintapalle (25km). Local guides available for all treks.

🌿 Eco Resort · Lambasingi
Hamsa Hill Eco Friendly Resort
A unique eco-resort featuring colourful geodesic dome tents, barrel cottages, and spacious family rooms — nestled against the Eastern Ghats mountain backdrop. Breakfast included with every stay. Free cancellation available. Just 6.1 km from Lambasingi centre.
